summary: The dirname filter returns the directory part of a path; unlike Unix dirname, a path with a trailing slash returns the full path.
questions: How do I get the directory of a file path in Ansible?
Why does dirname return /foo/bar/ instead of /foo?

answer_card.title: dirname filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ path | dirname }}` returns everything except the basename. Unlike Unix `dirname`, `/foo/bar/` returns `/foo/bar/` rather than `/foo`.
